statements.subject: connection
statements.description: CLOSED STATE (i.e., TCB does not exist): return 'error: connection illegal for this process' or 'error: connection does not exist'.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: LISTEN STATE: Queue RECEIVE for processing after entering ESTABLISHED state. If there is no room to queue this request, respond with 'error: insufficient resources'.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: SYN-SENT STATE: Queue RECEIVE for processing after entering ESTABLISHED state. If there is no room to queue this request, respond with 'error: insufficient resources'.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: SYN-RECEIVED STATE: Queue RECEIVE for processing after entering ESTABLISHED state. If there is no room to queue this request, respond with 'error: insufficient resources'.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: ESTABLISHED STATE: Reassemble queued incoming segments into receive buffer and return to user. Mark 'push seen' (PUSH) if applicable. When the TCP endpoint takes responsibility for delivering data to the user, that fact must be communicated to the sender via an acknowledgment.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: FIN-WAIT-1 STATE: If insufficient incoming segments are queued to satisfy the request, queue the request. Reassemble queued incoming segments into receive buffer and return to user.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: FIN-WAIT-2 STATE: If insufficient incoming segments are queued to satisfy the request, queue the request. Reassemble queued incoming segments into receive buffer and return to user.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: CLOSE-WAIT STATE: Since the remote side has already sent FIN, RECEIVEs must be satisfied by data already on hand, but not yet delivered to the user. If no text is awaiting delivery, the RECEIVE will get an 'error: connection closing' response.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If RCV.UP is in advance of the data currently being passed to the user, notify the user of the presence of urgent data.
statements.guard_semantics: RCV.UP > connection.current_data_pointer implies urgent data present

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: When the TCP endpoint takes responsibility for delivering data to the user, that fact must be communicated to the sender via an acknowledgment.
statements.trigger: RECEIVE call satisfied / data delivered to user
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = ESTABLISHED | connection.state = FIN-WAIT-1 | connection.state = FIN-WAIT-2
